attempts.cause: warehouse_api.on_hand does not account for the direction of stock moves, causing it to sum all quantities regardless of whether they were 'IN' or 'OUT'.

warehouse_api.on_hand was querying the wrong table (warehouse_bins instead of stock_moves) and the previous fix incorrectly assumed stock_moves was the source of truth while the original code used warehouse_bins.
warehouse_api.on_hand was querying the warehouse_bins table instead of calculating the balance from stock_moves.
